CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ohc_find_compatible_products(p_vehicle_brand text, p_vehicle_model text, p_vehicle_year integer, p_generation_chassis text, p_vehicle_version text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_brand_key text := public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(p_vehicle_brand);
  v_model_key text := public.ohc_normalize_vehicle_model(p_vehicle_brand, p_vehicle_model);
  v_generation_key text := public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(p_generation_chassis);
  v_version_key text := public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(p_vehicle_version);
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if v_brand_key = '' or v_model_key = '' or
     p_vehicle_year is null or p_vehicle_year < 1950 or p_vehicle_year > 2100 then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'matched', false,
      'conflict', false,
      'reason', 'invalid_input',
      'products', '[]'::jsonb
    );
  end if;

  with candidates as (
    select
      rule.id as rule_id,
      rule.product_sku,
      rule.product_sku_key,
      rule.status,
      rule.updated_at,
      product.marca,
      product.nome_produto,
      product.slug,
      product.imagem_principal,
      (case
        when rule.generation_key = v_generation_key and v_generation_key <> '' then 4
        when rule.generation_key = '' then 1
        else 0
      end) +
      (case
        when rule.version_key = v_version_key and v_version_key <> '' then 2
        when rule.version_key = '' then 1
        else 0
      end) as specificity
    from public.compatibility_rules as rule
    join public.catalog_products as product
      on product.ativo
     and public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(product.sku) = rule.product_sku_key
    where rule.active
      and rule.vehicle_brand_key = v_brand_key
      and rule.vehicle_model_key = v_model_key
      and p_vehicle_year between rule.year_from and rule.year_to
      and (rule.generation_key = '' or rule.generation_key = v_generation_key)
      and (rule.version_key = '' or rule.version_key = v_version_key)
  ), ranked as (
    select
      candidates.*,
      max(specificity) over (partition by product_sku_key) as best_specificity
    from candidates
  ), best as (
    select * from ranked where specificity = best_specificity
  ), summaries as (
    select
      product_sku,
      product_sku_key,
      marca,
      nome_produto,
      slug,
      imagem_principal,
      count(distinct status) as status_count,
      bool_or(status = 'compativel') as has_compatible,
      (array_agg(rule_id order by updated_at desc))[1] as rule_id
    from best
    group by product_sku, product_sku_key, marca, nome_produto, slug, imagem_principal
  ), compatible as (
    select * from summaries where status_count = 1 and has_compatible
  ), conflicts as (
    select count(*)::integer as conflict_count from summaries where status_count > 1
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'matched', exists(select 1 from compatible),
    'conflict', (select conflict_count > 0 from conflicts),
    'conflict_count', (select conflict_count from conflicts),
    'products', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'sku', product_sku,
          'brand', marca,
          'name', nome_produto,
          'slug', slug,
          'image', imagem_principal,
          'rule_id', rule_id
        ) order by marca, nome_produto, product_sku
      )
      from compatible
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) into v_result;

  return v_result;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ohc_normalize_vehicle_model(p_vehicle_brand text, p_vehicle_model text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case
    when public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(p_vehicle_model) like
         public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(p_vehicle_brand) || ' %'
      then trim(substr(
        public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(p_vehicle_model),
        length(public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(p_vehicle_brand)) + 1
      ))
    else public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(p_vehicle_model)
  end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ohc_normalize_vehicle_brand(value text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with normalized as (
    select public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(value) as key
  )
  select case
    when key in ('bmw', 'b m w', 'bayerische motoren werke') then 'bmw'
    when key in ('mercedes', 'mercedes benz', 'mercedesbenz', 'benz') then 'mercedes benz'
    when key in ('vw', 'volks', 'volkswagen') then 'volkswagen'
    when key in ('audi') then 'audi'
    when key in ('porsche') then 'porsche'
    when key in ('ford') then 'ford'
    when key in ('hyundai') then 'hyundai'
    when key in ('mitsubishi') then 'mitsubishi'
    else key
  end
  from normalized;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ohc_remove_normalized_vehicle_token(value text, token text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with normalized as (
    select
      public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(value) as value_key,
      public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(token) as token_key
  )
  select case
    when token_key = '' then value_key
    else trim(
      regexp_replace(
        replace(' ' || value_key || ' ', ' ' || token_key || ' ', ' '),
        '[[:space:]]+',
        ' ',
        'g'
      )
    )
  end
  from normalized;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ohc_get_vehicle_input_keys(p_vehicle_brand text, p_vehicle_model text, p_vehicle_year integer, p_vehicle_version text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_vehicle_generation text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_chassis_platform text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_motorization text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'brand_key', public.ohc_normalize_vehicle_brand(p_vehicle_brand),
    'model_key', public.ohc_normalize_vehicle_model_v2(
      p_vehicle_brand,
      p_vehicle_model,
      p_vehicle_year,
      p_vehicle_generation,
      p_chassis_platform
    ),
    'year', p_vehicle_year,
    'version_key', public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(p_vehicle_version),
    'generation_key', public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(p_vehicle_generation),
    'chassis_platform_key', public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(p_chassis_platform),
    'motorization_key', public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(p_motorization),
    'normalized_key', public.ohc_build_vehicle_normalized_key(
      p_vehicle_brand,
      p_vehicle_model,
      p_vehicle_year,
      p_vehicle_version,
      p_vehicle_generation,
      p_chassis_platform,
      p_motorization
    )
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ohc_identify_vehicle_profile(p_vehicle_brand text, p_vehicle_model text, p_vehicle_year integer, p_vehicle_version text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_vehicle_generation text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_chassis_platform text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_motorization text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_include_admin_suggestions boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_keys jsonb := public.ohc_get_vehicle_input_keys(
    p_vehicle_brand,
    p_vehicle_model,
    p_vehicle_year,
    p_vehicle_version,
    p_vehicle_generation,
    p_chassis_platform,
    p_motorization
  );
  v_brand_key text := v_keys ->> 'brand_key';
  v_model_key text := v_keys ->> 'model_key';
  v_version_key text := v_keys ->> 'version_key';
  v_generation_key text := v_keys ->> 'generation_key';
  v_chassis_key text := v_keys ->> 'chassis_platform_key';
  v_motorization_key text := v_keys ->> 'motorization_key';
  v_generation_input text;
  v_chassis_input text;
  v_candidate_count integer := 0;
  v_profile jsonb;
  v_suggestions jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
begin
  if v_brand_key = ''
     or v_model_key = ''
     or p_vehicle_year is null
     or p_vehicle_year < 1950
     or p_vehicle_year > 2100 then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'identified', false,
      'ambiguous', false,
      'reason', 'invalid_input',
      'normalized_input', v_keys,
      'profile', null,
      'suggestions', '[]'::jsonb
    );
  end if;

  v_generation_input := coalesce(nullif(v_generation_key, ''), nullif(v_chassis_key, ''), '');
  v_chassis_input := coalesce(nullif(v_chassis_key, ''), nullif(v_generation_key, ''), '');

  with candidates as (
    select
      profile.*,
      case
        when profile.vehicle_model_key = v_model_key then 'canonical_model'
        else 'approved_alias'
      end as match_method
    from public.compatibility_vehicle_profiles as profile
    where profile.active
      and profile.vehicle_brand_key = v_brand_key
      and p_vehicle_year between profile.year_from and profile.year_to
      and (
        profile.vehicle_model_key = v_model_key
        or exists (
          select 1
          from public.compatibility_vehicle_aliases as alias
          where alias.active
            and alias.vehicle_profile_id = profile.id
            and alias.alias_kind in ('model', 'manual')
            and alias.alias_key = v_model_key
        )
      )
      and (
        profile.version_key = ''
        or (v_version_key <> '' and profile.version_key = v_version_key)
      )
      and (
        profile.generation_key = ''
        or (v_generation_input <> '' and profile.generation_key = v_generation_input)
      )
      and (
        profile.chassis_platform_key = ''
        or (v_chassis_input <> '' and profile.chassis_platform_key = v_chassis_input)
      )
      and (
        profile.motorization_key = ''
        or (v_motorization_key <> '' and profile.motorization_key = v_motorization_key)
      )
  )
  select
    count(*)::integer,
    case
      when count(*) = 1 then
        (jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'id', id,
          'brand', vehicle_brand,
          'model', vehicle_model,
          'year_from', year_from,
          'year_to', year_to,
          'version', vehicle_version,
          'generation', vehicle_generation,
          'chassis_platform', chassis_platform,
          'motorization', motorization,
          'normalized_key', normalized_key,
          'matched_by', match_method
        )) -> 0)
      else null
    end
  into v_candidate_count, v_profile
  from candidates;

  if coalesce(p_include_admin_suggestions, false) and v_candidate_count = 0 then
    with similar_profiles as (
      select
        profile.*,
        array_remove(array[
          case
            when p_vehicle_year not between profile.year_from and profile.year_to then 'year'
          end,
          case
            when profile.version_key <> '' and profile.version_key <> v_version_key then 'version'
          end,
          case
            when profile.generation_key <> '' and profile.generation_key <> v_generation_input then 'generation'
          end,
          case
            when profile.chassis_platform_key <> '' and profile.chassis_platform_key <> v_chassis_input then 'chassis_platform'
          end,
          case
            when profile.motorization_key <> '' and profile.motorization_key <> v_motorization_key then 'motorization'
          end
        ], null) as mismatch_fields
      from public.compatibility_vehicle_profiles as profile
      where profile.active
        and profile.vehicle_brand_key = v_brand_key
        and (
          profile.vehicle_model_key = v_model_key
          or exists (
            select 1
            from public.compatibility_vehicle_aliases as alias
            where alias.active
              and alias.vehicle_profile_id = profile.id
              and alias.alias_kind in ('model', 'manual')
              and alias.alias_key = v_model_key
          )
        )
      order by
        abs(p_vehicle_year - greatest(profile.year_from, least(p_vehicle_year, profile.year_to))),
        profile.updated_at desc,
        profile.id
      limit 5
    )
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'profile_id', id,
      'brand', vehicle_brand,
      'model', vehicle_model,
      'year_from', year_from,
      'year_to', year_to,
      'version', vehicle_version,
      'generation', vehicle_generation,
      'chassis_platform', chassis_platform,
      'motorization', motorization,
      'mismatch_fields', to_jsonb(mismatch_fields),
      'suggestion_only', true
    )), '[]'::jsonb)
    into v_suggestions
    from similar_profiles;
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'identified', v_candidate_count = 1,
    'ambiguous', v_candidate_count > 1,
    'reason', case
      when v_candidate_count = 1 then 'exact_profile'
      when v_candidate_count > 1 then 'ambiguous_profile'
      else 'profile_not_found'
    end,
    'normalized_input', v_keys,
    'profile', v_profile,
    'suggestions', case
      when coalesce(p_include_admin_suggestions, false) then v_suggestions
      else '[]'::jsonb
    end
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ohc_get_admin_compatibility_context(p_request_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_request public.compatibility_requests%rowtype;
  v_brand_key text;
  v_model_key text;
  v_structure_key text;
  v_version_key text;
  v_query_count integer := 0;
  v_similar_cases jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_vehicle_suggestions jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_rules jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_conflicts jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_request
  from public.compatibility_requests
  where id = p_request_id;

  if not found then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'request_not_found');
  end if;

  v_brand_key := public.ohc_normalize_vehicle_brand(v_request.vehicle_brand);
  v_model_key := public.ohc_normalize_vehicle_model_v2(
    v_request.vehicle_brand,
    v_request.vehicle_model,
    v_request.vehicle_year,
    v_request.vehicle_generation,
    coalesce(v_request.vehicle_chassis_platform, v_request.generation_chassis)
  );
  v_structure_key := public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(
    coalesce(
      v_request.vehicle_chassis_platform,
      v_request.vehicle_generation,
      v_request.generation_chassis
    )
  );
  v_version_key := public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(v_request.vehicle_version);

  v_vehicle_suggestions := coalesce(
    public.ohc_identify_vehicle_profile(
      v_request.vehicle_brand,
      v_request.vehicle_model,
      v_request.vehicle_year,
      v_request.vehicle_version,
      v_request.vehicle_generation,
      coalesce(v_request.vehicle_chassis_platform, v_request.generation_chassis),
      v_request.vehicle_motorization,
      true
    ) -> 'suggestions',
    '[]'::jsonb
  );

  select count(*)::integer into v_query_count
  from public.compatibility_requests as candidate
  where public.ohc_normalize_vehicle_brand(candidate.vehicle_brand) = v_brand_key
    and public.ohc_normalize_vehicle_model_v2(
      candidate.vehicle_brand,
      candidate.vehicle_model,
      candidate.vehicle_year,
      candidate.vehicle_generation,
      coalesce(candidate.vehicle_chassis_platform, candidate.generation_chassis)
    ) = v_model_key
    and candidate.vehicle_year = v_request.vehicle_year
    and public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(candidate.vehicle_version) = v_version_key
    and public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(coalesce(
      candidate.vehicle_chassis_platform,
      candidate.vehicle_generation,
      candidate.generation_chassis
    )) = v_structure_key;

  with similar_requests as (
    select candidate.*
    from public.compatibility_requests as candidate
    where candidate.id <> v_request.id
      and public.ohc_normalize_vehicle_brand(candidate.vehicle_brand) = v_brand_key
      and public.ohc_normalize_vehicle_model_v2(
        candidate.vehicle_brand,
        candidate.vehicle_model,
        candidate.vehicle_year,
        candidate.vehicle_generation,
        coalesce(candidate.vehicle_chassis_platform, candidate.generation_chassis)
      ) = v_model_key
    order by
      abs(candidate.vehicle_year - v_request.vehicle_year),
      candidate.created_at desc
    limit 12
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', id,
    'protocol', protocol,
    'status', status,
    'vehicle_brand', vehicle_brand,
    'vehicle_model', vehicle_model,
    'vehicle_year', vehicle_year,
    'vehicle_version', vehicle_version,
    'generation_chassis', generation_chassis,
    'question', current_steering_notes,
    'recommended_product_skus', recommended_product_skus,
    'decision_source', decision_source,
    'reviewed_by', reviewed_by,
    'reviewed_at', reviewed_at,
    'created_at', created_at,
    'exact_vehicle',
      vehicle_year = v_request.vehicle_year
      and public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(vehicle_version) = v_version_key
      and public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(coalesce(
        vehicle_chassis_platform,
        vehicle_generation,
        generation_chassis
      )) = v_structure_key
  ) order by created_at desc), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_similar_cases
  from similar_requests;

  with relevant_rules as (
    select
      rule.*,
      profile.vehicle_brand as profile_brand,
      profile.vehicle_model as profile_model,
      profile.vehicle_brand_key as profile_brand_key,
      profile.vehicle_model_key as profile_model_key,
      profile.vehicle_generation,
      profile.generation_key as profile_generation_key,
      profile.chassis_platform,
      profile.chassis_platform_key,
      profile.motorization,
      product.nome_produto as product_name,
      product.marca as product_brand,
      product.ativo as product_active
    from public.compatibility_rules as rule
    join public.compatibility_vehicle_profiles as profile
      on profile.id = rule.vehicle_profile_id
    join public.catalog_products as product
      on product.id = rule.product_id
    where profile.vehicle_brand_key = v_brand_key
      and (
        profile.vehicle_model_key = v_model_key
        or (
          v_structure_key <> ''
          and profile.chassis_platform_key = v_structure_key
        )
      )
    order by rule.active desc, rule.updated_at desc
    limit 80
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', id,
    'decision_batch_id', decision_batch_id,
    'status', status,
    'active', active,
    'scope', rule_scope,
    'scope_explicitly_approved', scope_explicitly_approved,
    'year_from', year_from,
    'year_to', year_to,
    'vehicle_brand', profile_brand,
    'vehicle_model', profile_model,
    'vehicle_generation', vehicle_generation,
    'chassis_platform', chassis_platform,
    'motorization', motorization,
    'vehicle_version', vehicle_version,
    'product_id', product_id,
    'product_sku', product_sku,
    'product_name', product_name,
    'product_brand', product_brand,
    'product_active', product_active,
    'public_notes', public_notes,
    'internal_notes', internal_notes,
    'installation_conditions', installation_conditions,
    'confidence_level', confidence_level,
    'confirmed_by', confirmed_by,
    'confirmed_at', confirmed_at,
    'rule_version', rule_version,
    'updated_at', updated_at
  ) order by active desc, updated_at desc), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_rules
  from relevant_rules;

  with active_relevant as (
    select
      rule.product_id,
      product.sku,
      product.nome_produto,
      count(distinct rule.status) as status_count,
      array_agg(rule.id order by rule.updated_at desc) as rule_ids,
      array_agg(distinct rule.status) as statuses
    from public.compatibility_rules as rule
    join public.compatibility_vehicle_profiles as profile
      on profile.id = rule.vehicle_profile_id
    join public.catalog_products as product
      on product.id = rule.product_id
    where rule.active
      and profile.vehicle_brand_key = v_brand_key
      and (
        profile.vehicle_model_key = v_model_key
        or (v_structure_key <> '' and profile.chassis_platform_key = v_structure_key)
      )
      and v_request.vehicle_year between rule.year_from and rule.year_to
    group by rule.product_id, product.sku, product.nome_produto
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'product_id', product_id,
    'sku', sku,
    'product_name', nome_produto,
    'rule_ids', to_jsonb(rule_ids),
    'statuses', to_jsonb(statuses)
  )), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_conflicts
  from active_relevant
  where status_count > 1;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'request', jsonb_build_object(
      'id', v_request.id,
      'protocol', v_request.protocol,
      'status', v_request.status,
      'vehicle_brand', v_request.vehicle_brand,
      'vehicle_model', v_request.vehicle_model,
      'vehicle_year', v_request.vehicle_year,
      'vehicle_version', v_request.vehicle_version,
      'vehicle_generation', v_request.vehicle_generation,
      'vehicle_chassis_platform', v_request.vehicle_chassis_platform,
      'vehicle_motorization', v_request.vehicle_motorization,
      'generation_chassis', v_request.generation_chassis,
      'question', v_request.current_steering_notes,
      'internal_notes', v_request.admin_notes,
      'recommended_product_skus', v_request.recommended_product_skus,
      'decision_source', v_request.decision_source,
      'conflict_detected', v_request.conflict_detected,
      'reviewed_by', v_request.reviewed_by,
      'reviewed_at', v_request.reviewed_at,
      'created_at', v_request.created_at,
      'photos_expire_at', v_request.photos_expire_at,
      'query_count', v_query_count
    ),
    'similar_cases', v_similar_cases,
    'vehicle_suggestions', v_vehicle_suggestions,
    'rules', v_rules,
    'conflicts', v_conflicts
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ohc_find_compatibility_memory(p_vehicle_brand text, p_vehicle_model text, p_vehicle_year integer, p_vehicle_version text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_vehicle_generation text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_chassis_platform text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_motorization text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_include_admin_suggestions boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_keys jsonb := public.ohc_get_vehicle_input_keys(
    p_vehicle_brand,
    p_vehicle_model,
    p_vehicle_year,
    p_vehicle_version,
    p_vehicle_generation,
    p_chassis_platform,
    p_motorization
  );
  v_brand_key text := v_keys ->> 'brand_key';
  v_model_key text := v_keys ->> 'model_key';
  v_version_key text := v_keys ->> 'version_key';
  v_generation_key text := v_keys ->> 'generation_key';
  v_chassis_key text := v_keys ->> 'chassis_platform_key';
  v_motorization_key text := v_keys ->> 'motorization_key';
  v_generation_input text;
  v_chassis_input text;
  v_results jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_conflicts jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_conflict_count integer := 0;
  v_match_priority integer;
  v_identification jsonb;
begin
  if v_brand_key = ''
     or v_model_key = ''
     or p_vehicle_year is null
     or p_vehicle_year < 1950
     or p_vehicle_year > 2100 then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'matched', false,
      'conflict', false,
      'reason', 'invalid_input',
      'status', 'analise_necessaria',
      'normalized_input', v_keys,
      'results', '[]'::jsonb,
      'suggestions', '[]'::jsonb
    );
  end if;

  v_generation_input := coalesce(nullif(v_generation_key, ''), nullif(v_chassis_key, ''), '');
  v_chassis_input := coalesce(nullif(v_chassis_key, ''), nullif(v_generation_key, ''), '');

  with base_candidates as (
    select
      rule.id as rule_id,
      rule.decision_batch_id,
      rule.status,
      rule.rule_scope,
      rule.scope_explicitly_approved,
      rule.public_notes,
      rule.installation_conditions,
      rule.rule_version,
      rule.updated_at,
      product.id as product_id,
      product.sku,
      product.marca as product_brand,
      product.nome_produto as product_name,
      product.slug,
      product.imagem_principal as product_image,
      profile.vehicle_model_key = v_model_key
        or exists (
          select 1
          from public.compatibility_vehicle_aliases as alias
          where alias.active
            and alias.vehicle_profile_id = profile.id
            and alias.alias_kind in ('model', 'manual')
            and alias.alias_key = v_model_key
        ) as model_matches,
      profile.version_key,
      profile.generation_key,
      profile.chassis_platform_key,
      profile.motorization_key
    from public.compatibility_rules as rule
    join public.compatibility_vehicle_profiles as profile
      on profile.id = rule.vehicle_profile_id
     and profile.active
    join public.catalog_products as product
      on product.id = rule.product_id
     and product.ativo
    where rule.active
      and rule.status in ('compativel', 'incompativel', 'compativel_com_condicoes')
      and profile.vehicle_brand_key = v_brand_key
      and p_vehicle_year between rule.year_from and rule.year_to
      and p_vehicle_year between profile.year_from and profile.year_to
  ), scoped_candidates as (
    select
      base_candidates.*,
      case rule_scope
        when 'exact_vehicle_version' then 1
        when 'model_year_range' then 2
        when 'generation' then 3
        when 'chassis_platform' then 4
      end as match_priority
    from base_candidates
    where case rule_scope
      when 'exact_vehicle_version' then
        model_matches
        and version_key <> ''
        and version_key = v_version_key
        and (generation_key = '' or generation_key = v_generation_input)
        and (chassis_platform_key = '' or chassis_platform_key = v_chassis_input)
        and (motorization_key = '' or motorization_key = v_motorization_key)
      when 'model_year_range' then
        model_matches
        and (version_key = '' or version_key = v_version_key)
        and (generation_key = '' or generation_key = v_generation_input)
        and (chassis_platform_key = '' or chassis_platform_key = v_chassis_input)
        and (motorization_key = '' or motorization_key = v_motorization_key)
      when 'generation' then
        scope_explicitly_approved
        and model_matches
        and v_generation_input <> ''
        and generation_key = v_generation_input
      when 'chassis_platform' then
        scope_explicitly_approved
        and v_chassis_input <> ''
        and chassis_platform_key = v_chassis_input
      else false
    end
  ), ranked as (
    select
      scoped_candidates.*,
      min(match_priority) over (partition by product_id) as best_priority
    from scoped_candidates
  ), best as (
    select *
    from ranked
    where match_priority = best_priority
  ), summaries as (
    select
      product_id,
      sku,
      product_brand,
      product_name,
      slug,
      product_image,
      min(match_priority) as match_priority,
      count(distinct status)::integer as status_count,
      (array_agg(status order by updated_at desc, rule_id))[1] as status,
      (array_agg(rule_id order by updated_at desc, rule_id))[1] as rule_id,
      (array_agg(decision_batch_id order by updated_at desc, rule_id))[1] as decision_batch_id,
      (array_agg(rule_scope order by updated_at desc, rule_id))[1] as rule_scope,
      (array_agg(public_notes order by updated_at desc, rule_id))[1] as public_notes,
      (array_agg(installation_conditions order by updated_at desc, rule_id))[1] as installation_conditions,
      (array_agg(rule_version order by updated_at desc, rule_id))[1] as rule_version,
      array_agg(rule_id order by updated_at desc, rule_id) as rule_ids
    from best
    group by product_id, sku, product_brand, product_name, slug, product_image
  )
  select
    coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'product_id', product_id,
      'sku', sku,
      'brand', product_brand,
      'name', product_name,
      'slug', slug,
      'image', product_image,
      'status', status,
      'result_label', case status
        when 'compativel' then 'Compatível'
        when 'incompativel' then 'Não compatível'
        when 'compativel_com_condicoes' then 'Compatível com condições'
      end,
      'rule_id', rule_id,
      'decision_batch_id', decision_batch_id,
      'rule_scope', rule_scope,
      'match_priority', match_priority,
      'public_notes', public_notes,
      'installation_conditions', installation_conditions,
      'rule_version', rule_version
    ) order by match_priority, product_brand, product_name, sku)
      filter (where status_count = 1), '[]'::jsonb),
    coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'product_id', product_id,
      'sku', sku,
      'name', product_name,
      'rule_ids', to_jsonb(rule_ids),
      'requires_admin_confirmation', true
    )) filter (where status_count > 1), '[]'::jsonb),
    (count(*) filter (where status_count > 1))::integer,
    min(match_priority)
  into v_results, v_conflicts, v_conflict_count, v_match_priority
  from summaries;

  if coalesce(v_conflict_count, 0) > 0 then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'matched', false,
      'conflict', true,
      'reason', 'rule_conflict',
      'status', 'analise_necessaria',
      'normalized_input', v_keys,
      'match_priority', v_match_priority,
      'results', '[]'::jsonb,
      'conflicts', v_conflicts,
      'suggestions', '[]'::jsonb
    );
  end if;

  if jsonb_array_length(v_results) > 0 then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'matched', true,
      'conflict', false,
      'reason', 'approved_rule',
      'status', 'regra_aprovada',
      'normalized_input', v_keys,
      'match_priority', v_match_priority,
      'results', v_results,
      'conflicts', '[]'::jsonb,
      'suggestions', '[]'::jsonb
    );
  end if;

  v_identification := public.ohc_identify_vehicle_profile(
    p_vehicle_brand,
    p_vehicle_model,
    p_vehicle_year,
    p_vehicle_version,
    p_vehicle_generation,
    p_chassis_platform,
    p_motorization,
    coalesce(p_include_admin_suggestions, false)
  );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'matched', false,
    'conflict', false,
    'reason', 'analysis_required',
    'status', 'analise_necessaria',
    'normalized_input', v_keys,
    'match_priority', null,
    'results', '[]'::jsonb,
    'conflicts', '[]'::jsonb,
    'suggestions', case
      when coalesce(p_include_admin_suggestions, false)
        then coalesce(v_identification -> 'suggestions', '[]'::jsonb)
      else '[]'::jsonb
    end
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ohc_save_compatibility_decision_v2(p_request_id uuid, p_status text, p_product_ids bigint[], p_public_notes text, p_internal_notes text, p_installation_conditions text, p_confidence_level text, p_rule_scope text, p_year_from integer, p_year_to integer, p_reviewed_by text, p_save_rule boolean, p_replace_conflicts boolean, p_scope_explicitly_approved boolean, p_change_reason text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_request public.compatibility_requests%rowtype;
  v_profile_id uuid;
  v_profile_key text;
  v_batch_id uuid := gen_random_uuid();
  v_brand_key text;
  v_model_key text;
  v_version_key text;
  v_generation_key text;
  v_chassis_key text;
  v_motorization_key text;
  v_rule_structure text;
  v_rule_structure_key text;
  v_year_from integer;
  v_year_to integer;
  v_product_count integer := 0;
  v_product_ids bigint[] := array[]::bigint[];
  v_product_skus text[] := array[]::text[];
  v_conflict_ids uuid[] := array[]::uuid[];
  v_conflicts jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_rule_ids uuid[] := array[]::uuid[];
  v_same_ids uuid[];
  v_rule_id uuid;
  v_primary_rule_id uuid;
  v_resolved_count integer := 0;
  v_product record;
  v_existing public.compatibility_rules%rowtype;
  v_previous jsonb;
  v_new jsonb;
begin
  if p_status not in (
    'analise_necessaria',
    'compativel',
    'incompativel',
    'compativel_com_condicoes'
  ) then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'invalid_status');
  end if;

  if p_confidence_level not in ('low', 'medium', 'high', 'confirmed') then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'invalid_confidence');
  end if;

  if p_rule_scope not in (
    'exact_vehicle_version',
    'model_year_range',
    'generation',
    'chassis_platform'
  ) then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'invalid_scope');
  end if;

  select * into v_request
  from public.compatibility_requests
  where id = p_request_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'request_not_found');
  end if;

  select
    count(*)::integer,
    coalesce(array_agg(product.id order by product.id), array[]::bigint[]),
    coalesce(array_agg(product.sku order by product.id), array[]::text[])
  into v_product_count, v_product_ids, v_product_skus
  from public.catalog_products as product
  where product.ativo
    and product.id = any(coalesce(p_product_ids, array[]::bigint[]));

  if p_status <> 'analise_necessaria'
     and (
       v_product_count = 0
       or v_product_count <> cardinality(array(select distinct unnest(coalesce(p_product_ids, array[]::bigint[]))))
     ) then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'active_products_required');
  end if;

  if p_status = 'compativel_com_condicoes'
     and nullif(trim(coalesce(p_installation_conditions, '')), '') is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'conditions_required');
  end if;

  if p_status = 'analise_necessaria' or not coalesce(p_save_rule, false) then
    update public.compatibility_requests
    set
      status = p_status,
      recommended_product_skus = case
        when p_status in ('compativel', 'compativel_com_condicoes') then v_product_skus
        else array[]::text[]
      end,
      admin_notes = nullif(trim(p_internal_notes), ''),
      reviewed_by = case
        when p_status = 'analise_necessaria' then null
        else nullif(trim(p_reviewed_by), '')
      end,
      reviewed_at = case
        when p_status = 'analise_necessaria' then null
        else now()
      end,
      matched_rule_id = null,
      decision_batch_id = case
        when p_status = 'analise_necessaria' then null
        else v_batch_id
      end,
      decision_source = 'manual_review',
      conflict_detected = false,
      result_presented = jsonb_build_object(
        'status', p_status,
        'recommended_product_skus', case
          when p_status in ('compativel', 'compativel_com_condicoes') then v_product_skus
          else array[]::text[]
        end,
        'public_notes', nullif(trim(p_public_notes), ''),
        'installation_conditions', nullif(trim(p_installation_conditions), ''),
        'saved_as_rule', false
      ),
      updated_at = now()
    where id = p_request_id;

    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', true,
      'rule_saved', false,
      'status', p_status,
      'decision_batch_id', v_batch_id,
      'resolved_equivalent_requests', 0
    );
  end if;

  if p_status = 'analise_necessaria' then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'analysis_cannot_create_rule');
  end if;

  v_year_from := case
    when p_rule_scope = 'exact_vehicle_version' then v_request.vehicle_year
    else coalesce(p_year_from, v_request.vehicle_year)
  end;
  v_year_to := case
    when p_rule_scope = 'exact_vehicle_version' then v_request.vehicle_year
    else coalesce(p_year_to, v_request.vehicle_year)
  end;

  if v_year_from < 1950 or v_year_to > 2100 or v_year_from > v_year_to then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'invalid_year_range');
  end if;

  v_brand_key := public.ohc_normalize_vehicle_brand(v_request.vehicle_brand);
  v_model_key := public.ohc_normalize_vehicle_model_v2(
    v_request.vehicle_brand,
    v_request.vehicle_model,
    v_request.vehicle_year,
    v_request.vehicle_generation,
    coalesce(v_request.vehicle_chassis_platform, v_request.generation_chassis)
  );
  v_version_key := case
    when p_rule_scope = 'exact_vehicle_version'
      then public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(v_request.vehicle_version)
    else ''
  end;
  v_generation_key := case
    when p_rule_scope = 'generation'
      then public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(coalesce(
        v_request.vehicle_generation,
        v_request.generation_chassis
      ))
    else ''
  end;
  v_chassis_key := case
    when p_rule_scope in ('exact_vehicle_version', 'model_year_range', 'chassis_platform')
      then public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(coalesce(
        v_request.vehicle_chassis_platform,
        v_request.generation_chassis
      ))
    else ''
  end;
  v_motorization_key := case
    when p_rule_scope = 'exact_vehicle_version'
      then public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(v_request.vehicle_motorization)
    else ''
  end;

  if p_rule_scope = 'exact_vehicle_version' and v_version_key = '' then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'version_required_for_exact_scope');
  end if;

  if p_rule_scope = 'generation'
     and (v_generation_key = '' or not coalesce(p_scope_explicitly_approved, false)) then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'explicit_generation_approval_required');
  end if;

  if p_rule_scope = 'chassis_platform'
     and (v_chassis_key = '' or not coalesce(p_scope_explicitly_approved, false)) then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'explicit_chassis_approval_required');
  end if;

  v_rule_structure := case
    when p_rule_scope = 'generation' then coalesce(v_request.vehicle_generation, v_request.generation_chassis)
    else coalesce(v_request.vehicle_chassis_platform, v_request.generation_chassis)
  end;
  v_rule_structure_key := case
    when p_rule_scope = 'generation' then v_generation_key
    else v_chassis_key
  end;

  -- Reaproveita e amplia faixas equivalentes do mesmo resultado, evitando
  -- criar regras ativas duplicadas para anos sobrepostos ou adjacentes.
  select
    least(v_year_from, coalesce(min(rule.year_from), v_year_from)),
    greatest(v_year_to, coalesce(max(rule.year_to), v_year_to))
  into v_year_from, v_year_to
  from public.compatibility_rules as rule
  where rule.active
    and rule.product_id = any(v_product_ids)
    and rule.vehicle_brand_key = v_brand_key
    and rule.vehicle_model_key = v_model_key
    and rule.generation_key = v_rule_structure_key
    and rule.version_key = v_version_key
    and rule.status = p_status
    and rule.year_from <= v_year_to + 1
    and rule.year_to + 1 >= v_year_from;

  v_profile_key := concat(
    v_brand_key, '|', v_model_key, '|', v_year_from, '-', v_year_to, '|',
    v_version_key, '|', v_generation_key, '|', v_chassis_key, '|', v_motorization_key
  );

  insert into public.compatibility_vehicle_profiles (
    vehicle_brand,
    vehicle_brand_key,
    vehicle_model,
    vehicle_model_key,
    year_from,
    year_to,
    vehicle_version,
    version_key,
    vehicle_generation,
    generation_key,
    chassis_platform,
    chassis_platform_key,
    motorization,
    motorization_key,
    normalized_key
  ) values (
    v_request.vehicle_brand,
    v_brand_key,
    v_request.vehicle_model,
    v_model_key,
    v_year_from,
    v_year_to,
    case when v_version_key <> '' then v_request.vehicle_version else null end,
    v_version_key,
    case when v_generation_key <> '' then v_rule_structure else null end,
    v_generation_key,
    case when v_chassis_key <> '' then v_rule_structure else null end,
    v_chassis_key,
    case when v_motorization_key <> '' then v_request.vehicle_motorization else null end,
    v_motorization_key,
    v_profile_key
  )
  on conflict (normalized_key) do update set
    active = true,
    updated_at = now()
  returning id into v_profile_id;

  -- Conflitos abrangem qualquer regra ativa que possa responder o mesmo
  -- produto, marca, anos e estrutura com outro resultado.
  with conflicts as (
    select
      rule.id,
      rule.status,
      rule.rule_scope,
      rule.product_id,
      rule.product_sku,
      rule.year_from,
      rule.year_to,
      rule.public_notes,
      rule.installation_conditions,
      rule.rule_version,
      profile.vehicle_model_key,
      profile.generation_key,
      profile.chassis_platform_key
    from public.compatibility_rules as rule
    join public.compatibility_vehicle_profiles as profile
      on profile.id = rule.vehicle_profile_id
    where rule.active
      and rule.product_id = any(v_product_ids)
      and profile.vehicle_brand_key = v_brand_key
      and rule.status <> p_status
      and rule.year_from <= v_year_to
      and rule.year_to >= v_year_from
      and (
        (
          p_rule_scope = 'chassis_platform'
          and v_chassis_key <> ''
          and profile.chassis_platform_key = v_chassis_key
        )
        or (
          rule.rule_scope = 'chassis_platform'
          and profile.chassis_platform_key <> ''
          and profile.chassis_platform_key = v_chassis_key
        )
        or (
          profile.vehicle_model_key = v_model_key
          and (
            profile.generation_key = ''
            or v_generation_key = ''
            or profile.generation_key = v_generation_key
          )
          and (
            profile.chassis_platform_key = ''
            or v_chassis_key = ''
            or profile.chassis_platform_key = v_chassis_key
          )
        )
      )
  )
  select
    coalesce(array_agg(id order by id), array[]::uuid[]),
    coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'rule_id', id,
      'product_id', product_id,
      'product_sku', product_sku,
      'previous_status', status,
      'new_status', p_status,
      'scope', rule_scope,
      'year_from', year_from,
      'year_to', year_to,
      'public_notes', public_notes,
      'installation_conditions', installation_conditions,
      'rule_version', rule_version
    )), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_conflict_ids, v_conflicts
  from conflicts;

  if cardinality(v_conflict_ids) > 0 and not coalesce(p_replace_conflicts, false) then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', false,
      'conflict', true,
      'error', 'conflicting_rules_require_confirmation',
      'conflict_count', cardinality(v_conflict_ids),
      'conflicts', v_conflicts,
      'proposed_response', jsonb_build_object(
        'status', p_status,
        'product_ids', to_jsonb(v_product_ids),
        'scope', p_rule_scope,
        'year_from', v_year_from,
        'year_to', v_year_to,
        'public_notes', nullif(trim(p_public_notes), ''),
        'installation_conditions', nullif(trim(p_installation_conditions), '')
      )
    );
  end if;

  if cardinality(v_conflict_ids) > 0 then
    insert into public.compatibility_rule_audit (
      rule_id,
      request_id,
      decision_batch_id,
      action,
      previous_status,
      new_status,
      actor,
      previous_response,
      new_response,
      change_reason,
      previous_rule_version,
      new_rule_version,
      details
    )
    select
      rule.id,
      p_request_id,
      v_batch_id,
      'corrected',
      rule.status,
      p_status,
      nullif(trim(p_reviewed_by), ''),
      jsonb_build_object(
        'status', rule.status,
        'active', rule.active,
        'scope', rule.rule_scope,
        'year_from', rule.year_from,
        'year_to', rule.year_to,
        'public_notes', rule.public_notes,
        'installation_conditions', rule.installation_conditions
      ),
      jsonb_build_object(
        'status', p_status,
        'active', false,
        'replacement_batch_id', v_batch_id
      ),
      coalesce(nullif(trim(p_change_reason), ''), 'Correção de regra conflitante'),
      rule.rule_version,
      rule.rule_version + 1,
      jsonb_build_object('replacement_confirmed', true)
    from public.compatibility_rules as rule
    where rule.id = any(v_conflict_ids);

    update public.compatibility_rules
    set
      active = false,
      rule_version = rule_version + 1,
      updated_at = now()
    where id = any(v_conflict_ids);
  end if;

  for v_product in
    select product.id, product.sku
    from public.catalog_products as product
    where product.id = any(v_product_ids)
    order by product.id
  loop
    select coalesce(array_agg(rule.id order by rule.created_at), array[]::uuid[])
    into v_same_ids
    from public.compatibility_rules as rule
    where rule.active
      and rule.product_id = v_product.id
      and rule.vehicle_brand_key = v_brand_key
      and rule.vehicle_model_key = v_model_key
      and rule.generation_key = v_rule_structure_key
      and rule.version_key = v_version_key
      and rule.status = p_status
      and rule.year_from <= v_year_to + 1
      and rule.year_to + 1 >= v_year_from;

    if cardinality(v_same_ids) = 1 then
      select * into v_existing
      from public.compatibility_rules
      where id = v_same_ids[1]
      for update;

      v_previous := jsonb_build_object(
        'status', v_existing.status,
        'active', v_existing.active,
        'scope', v_existing.rule_scope,
        'year_from', v_existing.year_from,
        'year_to', v_existing.year_to,
        'public_notes', v_existing.public_notes,
        'internal_notes', v_existing.internal_notes,
        'installation_conditions', v_existing.installation_conditions,
        'confidence_level', v_existing.confidence_level,
        'product_id', v_existing.product_id
      );

      update public.compatibility_rules
      set
        vehicle_profile_id = v_profile_id,
        decision_batch_id = v_batch_id,
        year_from = least(year_from, v_year_from),
        year_to = greatest(year_to, v_year_to),
        rule_scope = p_rule_scope,
        scope_explicitly_approved = case
          when p_rule_scope in ('generation', 'chassis_platform') then true
          else false
        end,
        public_notes = nullif(trim(p_public_notes), ''),
        internal_notes = nullif(trim(p_internal_notes), ''),
        admin_notes = nullif(trim(p_internal_notes), ''),
        installation_conditions = nullif(trim(p_installation_conditions), ''),
        confidence_level = p_confidence_level,
        confirmed_by = nullif(trim(p_reviewed_by), ''),
        confirmed_at = now(),
        reviewed_by = nullif(trim(p_reviewed_by), ''),
        evidence_request_id = p_request_id,
        rule_version = rule_version + 1,
        updated_at = now()
      where id = v_existing.id
      returning id into v_rule_id;

      select jsonb_build_object(
        'status', rule.status,
        'active', rule.active,
        'scope', rule.rule_scope,
        'year_from', rule.year_from,
        'year_to', rule.year_to,
        'public_notes', rule.public_notes,
        'internal_notes', rule.internal_notes,
        'installation_conditions', rule.installation_conditions,
        'confidence_level', rule.confidence_level,
        'product_id', rule.product_id
      ) into v_new
      from public.compatibility_rules as rule
      where rule.id = v_rule_id;

      insert into public.compatibility_rule_audit (
        rule_id, request_id, decision_batch_id, action,
        previous_status, new_status, actor,
        previous_response, new_response, change_reason,
        previous_rule_version, new_rule_version, details
      ) values (
        v_rule_id, p_request_id, v_batch_id, 'updated',
        p_status, p_status, nullif(trim(p_reviewed_by), ''),
        v_previous, v_new,
        coalesce(nullif(trim(p_change_reason), ''), 'Atualização administrativa'),
        v_existing.rule_version, v_existing.rule_version + 1,
        jsonb_build_object('product_id', v_product.id, 'product_sku', v_product.sku)
      );
    else
      if cardinality(v_same_ids) > 1 then
        insert into public.compatibility_rule_audit (
          rule_id, request_id, decision_batch_id, action,
          previous_status, new_status, actor,
          previous_response, new_response, change_reason,
          previous_rule_version, new_rule_version, details
        )
        select
          rule.id, p_request_id, v_batch_id, 'merged',
          rule.status, p_status, nullif(trim(p_reviewed_by), ''),
          jsonb_build_object(
            'status', rule.status,
            'active', rule.active,
            'year_from', rule.year_from,
            'year_to', rule.year_to
          ),
          jsonb_build_object('status', p_status, 'active', false, 'merged_into_batch', v_batch_id),
          coalesce(nullif(trim(p_change_reason), ''), 'Consolidação de regras equivalentes'),
          rule.rule_version, rule.rule_version + 1,
          jsonb_build_object('product_id', v_product.id)
        from public.compatibility_rules as rule
        where rule.id = any(v_same_ids);

        update public.compatibility_rules
        set active = false, rule_version = rule_version + 1, updated_at = now()
        where id = any(v_same_ids);
      end if;

      insert into public.compatibility_rules (
        product_id,
        product_sku,
        product_sku_key,
        vehicle_profile_id,
        decision_batch_id,
        vehicle_brand,
        vehicle_brand_key,
        vehicle_model,
        vehicle_model_key,
        generation_chassis,
        generation_key,
        vehicle_version,
        version_key,
        year_from,
        year_to,
        status,
        rule_scope,
        scope_explicitly_approved,
        public_notes,
        internal_notes,
        admin_notes,
        installation_conditions,
        confidence_level,
        confirmed_by,
        confirmed_at,
        evidence_request_id,
        reviewed_by,
        rule_version,
        active
      ) values (
        v_product.id,
        v_product.sku,
        public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(v_product.sku),
        v_profile_id,
        v_batch_id,
        v_request.vehicle_brand,
        v_brand_key,
        v_request.vehicle_model,
        v_model_key,
        nullif(trim(v_rule_structure), ''),
        v_rule_structure_key,
        case when v_version_key <> '' then v_request.vehicle_version else null end,
        v_version_key,
        v_year_from,
        v_year_to,
        p_status,
        p_rule_scope,
        case when p_rule_scope in ('generation', 'chassis_platform') then true else false end,
        nullif(trim(p_public_notes), ''),
        nullif(trim(p_internal_notes), ''),
        nullif(trim(p_internal_notes), ''),
        nullif(trim(p_installation_conditions), ''),
        p_confidence_level,
        nullif(trim(p_reviewed_by), ''),
        now(),
        p_request_id,
        nullif(trim(p_reviewed_by), ''),
        1,
        true
      ) returning id into v_rule_id;

      insert into public.compatibility_rule_audit (
        rule_id, request_id, decision_batch_id, action,
        new_status, actor, new_response, change_reason,
        new_rule_version, details
      ) values (
        v_rule_id, p_request_id, v_batch_id, 'created',
        p_status, nullif(trim(p_reviewed_by), ''),
        jsonb_build_object(
          'status', p_status,
          'active', true,
          'scope', p_rule_scope,
          'year_from', v_year_from,
          'year_to', v_year_to,
          'public_notes', nullif(trim(p_public_notes), ''),
          'internal_notes', nullif(trim(p_internal_notes), ''),
          'installation_conditions', nullif(trim(p_installation_conditions), ''),
          'confidence_level', p_confidence_level,
          'product_id', v_product.id
        ),
        coalesce(nullif(trim(p_change_reason), ''), 'Nova confirmação administrativa'),
        1,
        jsonb_build_object('product_id', v_product.id, 'product_sku', v_product.sku)
      );
    end if;

    v_rule_ids := array_append(v_rule_ids, v_rule_id);
    if v_primary_rule_id is null then v_primary_rule_id := v_rule_id; end if;
  end loop;

  -- Atualiza todas as consultas pendentes realmente equivalentes ao escopo.
  update public.compatibility_requests as candidate
  set
    status = p_status,
    recommended_product_skus = case
      when p_status in ('compativel', 'compativel_com_condicoes') then v_product_skus
      else array[]::text[]
    end,
    admin_notes = case
      when candidate.id = p_request_id then nullif(trim(p_internal_notes), '')
      else candidate.admin_notes
    end,
    reviewed_by = nullif(trim(p_reviewed_by), ''),
    reviewed_at = now(),
    matched_rule_id = v_primary_rule_id,
    decision_batch_id = v_batch_id,
    decision_source = case
      when candidate.id = p_request_id then 'manual_review'
      else 'learned_rule'
    end,
    conflict_detected = false,
    vehicle_profile_id = v_profile_id,
    vehicle_normalized_key = public.ohc_build_vehicle_normalized_key(
      candidate.vehicle_brand,
      candidate.vehicle_model,
      candidate.vehicle_year,
      candidate.vehicle_version,
      candidate.vehicle_generation,
      coalesce(candidate.vehicle_chassis_platform, candidate.generation_chassis),
      candidate.vehicle_motorization
    ),
    result_presented = jsonb_build_object(
      'status', p_status,
      'recommended_product_skus', case
        when p_status in ('compativel', 'compativel_com_condicoes') then v_product_skus
        else array[]::text[]
      end,
      'public_notes', nullif(trim(p_public_notes), ''),
      'installation_conditions', nullif(trim(p_installation_conditions), ''),
      'matched_rule_id', v_primary_rule_id,
      'decision_batch_id', v_batch_id,
      'saved_as_rule', true
    ),
    updated_at = now()
  where candidate.status = 'analise_necessaria'
    and public.ohc_normalize_vehicle_brand(candidate.vehicle_brand) = v_brand_key
    and candidate.vehicle_year between v_year_from and v_year_to
    and case p_rule_scope
      when 'exact_vehicle_version' then
        public.ohc_normalize_vehicle_model_v2(
          candidate.vehicle_brand,
          candidate.vehicle_model,
          candidate.vehicle_year,
          candidate.vehicle_generation,
          coalesce(candidate.vehicle_chassis_platform, candidate.generation_chassis)
        ) = v_model_key
        and candidate.vehicle_year = v_request.vehicle_year
        and public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(candidate.vehicle_version) = v_version_key
        and public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(coalesce(
          candidate.vehicle_chassis_platform,
          candidate.generation_chassis
        )) = v_chassis_key
      when 'model_year_range' then
        public.ohc_normalize_vehicle_model_v2(
          candidate.vehicle_brand,
          candidate.vehicle_model,
          candidate.vehicle_year,
          candidate.vehicle_generation,
          coalesce(candidate.vehicle_chassis_platform, candidate.generation_chassis)
        ) = v_model_key
        and (
          v_chassis_key = ''
          or public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(coalesce(
            candidate.vehicle_chassis_platform,
            candidate.generation_chassis
          )) = v_chassis_key
        )
      when 'generation' then
        public.ohc_normalize_vehicle_model_v2(
          candidate.vehicle_brand,
          candidate.vehicle_model,
          candidate.vehicle_year,
          candidate.vehicle_generation,
          coalesce(candidate.vehicle_chassis_platform, candidate.generation_chassis)
        ) = v_model_key
        and public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(coalesce(
          candidate.vehicle_generation,
          candidate.generation_chassis
        )) = v_generation_key
      when 'chassis_platform' then
        public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(coalesce(
          candidate.vehicle_chassis_platform,
          candidate.generation_chassis
        )) = v_chassis_key
      else false
    end;

  get diagnostics v_resolved_count = row_count;

  -- Caso a solicitação original já não estivesse pendente, garante a gravação.
  update public.compatibility_requests
  set
    status = p_status,
    recommended_product_skus = case
      when p_status in ('compativel', 'compativel_com_condicoes') then v_product_skus
      else array[]::text[]
    end,
    admin_notes = nullif(trim(p_internal_notes), ''),
    reviewed_by = nullif(trim(p_reviewed_by), ''),
    reviewed_at = now(),
    matched_rule_id = v_primary_rule_id,
    decision_batch_id = v_batch_id,
    decision_source = 'manual_review',
    conflict_detected = false,
    vehicle_profile_id = v_profile_id,
    vehicle_normalized_key = public.ohc_build_vehicle_normalized_key(
      v_request.vehicle_brand,
      v_request.vehicle_model,
      v_request.vehicle_year,
      v_request.vehicle_version,
      v_request.vehicle_generation,
      coalesce(v_request.vehicle_chassis_platform, v_request.generation_chassis),
      v_request.vehicle_motorization
    ),
    result_presented = jsonb_build_object(
      'status', p_status,
      'recommended_product_skus', case
        when p_status in ('compativel', 'compativel_com_condicoes') then v_product_skus
        else array[]::text[]
      end,
      'public_notes', nullif(trim(p_public_notes), ''),
      'installation_conditions', nullif(trim(p_installation_conditions), ''),
      'matched_rule_id', v_primary_rule_id,
      'decision_batch_id', v_batch_id,
      'saved_as_rule', true
    ),
    updated_at = now()
  where id = p_request_id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'rule_saved', true,
    'status', p_status,
    'decision_batch_id', v_batch_id,
    'rule_ids', to_jsonb(v_rule_ids),
    'product_ids', to_jsonb(v_product_ids),
    'product_skus', to_jsonb(v_product_skus),
    'resolved_equivalent_requests', greatest(v_resolved_count - 1, 0),
    'replaced_conflicts', cardinality(v_conflict_ids),
    'year_from', v_year_from,
    'year_to', v_year_to,
    'scope', p_rule_scope
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ohc_deactivate_compatibility_rule(p_rule_id uuid, p_actor text, p_reason text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_rule public.compatibility_rules%rowtype;
begin
  select * into v_rule
  from public.compatibility_rules
  where id = p_rule_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'rule_not_found');
  end if;

  if not v_rule.active then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'already_inactive', true, 'rule_id', v_rule.id);
  end if;

  update public.compatibility_rules
  set active = false, rule_version = rule_version + 1, updated_at = now()
  where id = v_rule.id;

  insert into public.compatibility_rule_audit (
    rule_id,
    request_id,
    decision_batch_id,
    action,
    previous_status,
    new_status,
    actor,
    previous_response,
    new_response,
    change_reason,
    previous_rule_version,
    new_rule_version,
    details
  ) values (
    v_rule.id,
    v_rule.evidence_request_id,
    v_rule.decision_batch_id,
    'deactivated',
    v_rule.status,
    v_rule.status,
    nullif(trim(p_actor), ''),
    jsonb_build_object('active', true, 'status', v_rule.status, 'scope', v_rule.rule_scope),
    jsonb_build_object('active', false, 'status', v_rule.status, 'scope', v_rule.rule_scope),
    coalesce(nullif(trim(p_reason), ''), 'Desativação administrativa'),
    v_rule.rule_version,
    v_rule.rule_version + 1,
    jsonb_build_object('product_id', v_rule.product_id, 'product_sku', v_rule.product_sku)
  );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'rule_id', v_rule.id,
    'active', false,
    'rule_version', v_rule.rule_version + 1
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ohc_bmw_compatibility_suggestions(vehicle_brand text, vehicle_model text, generation_chassis text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  search_text text := upper(
    coalesce(vehicle_brand, '') || ' ' ||
    coalesce(vehicle_model, '') || ' ' ||
    coalesce(generation_chassis, '')
  );
  has_chassis boolean;
  suggestions text;
begin
  if upper(coalesce(vehicle_brand, '')) not like '%BMW%'
     and search_text not like '%BMW%' then
    return null;
  end if;

  has_chassis := search_text ~ '(^|[^A-Z0-9])[EFG][0-9]{2}([^A-Z0-9]|$)';

  with candidates as (
    select
      p.sku,
      p.nome_produto,
      p.tipo_cubo_adaptador,
      exists (
        select 1
        from regexp_matches(
          upper(coalesce(p.geracao_chassi, '')),
          '([EFG][0-9]{2})',
          'g'
        ) as chassis_code
        where search_text ~ (
          '(^|[^A-Z0-9])' || chassis_code[1] || '([^A-Z0-9]|$)'
        )
      ) as chassis_match,
      case
        when search_text ~ '(^|[^A-Z0-9])M3([^A-Z0-9]|$)'
             and upper(coalesce(p.nome_produto, '')) like '%M3%' then 25
        when search_text ~ '(^|[^A-Z0-9])M5([^A-Z0-9]|$)'
             and upper(coalesce(p.nome_produto, '')) like '%M5%' then 25
        else 0
      end as model_score
    from public.catalog_products p
    where p.ativo is true
      and upper(coalesce(p.marca, '')) = 'BMW'
      and upper(coalesce(p.tipo_produto, '')) like '%VOLANTE%'
      and coalesce(p.sku, '') <> ''
      and coalesce(p.compatibilidade, '') <> ''
  ),
  ranked as (
    select *, (case when chassis_match then 100 else 0 end) + model_score as score
    from candidates
    where (has_chassis and chassis_match)
       or (not has_chassis and model_score > 0)
  ),
  top_matches as (
    select *
    from ranked
    order by score desc, sku
    limit 12
  )
  select string_agg(
    'SKU ' || sku || ' — ' || nome_produto ||
    ' — ' || coalesce(tipo_cubo_adaptador, 'Plataforma a confirmar'),
    E'\n'
    order by score desc, sku
  )
  into suggestions
  from top_matches;

  if suggestions is null then
    return 'Base BMW OHC: nenhum volante foi associado automaticamente. Confirmar manualmente modelo, geração/chassi e airbag.';
  end if;

  return
    'Base BMW OHC — sugestões automáticas (confirmar manualmente antes de aprovar):' ||
    E'\n' || suggestions;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ohc_normalize_compatibility_text(value text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select trim(
    regexp_replace(
      translate(
        lower(coalesce(value, '')),
        'áàâãäéèêëíìîïóòôõöúùûüç',
        'aaaaaeeeeiiiiooooouuuuc'
      ),
      '[^a-z0-9]+',
      ' ',
      'g'
    )
  );
$function$
